reference: FINDING: The Tamil National Liberation Alliance (TNLA) was launched in 2010 as a breakaway faction of the Tamil National Alliance (TNA) and represented the Sri Lankan Tamil ethnic minority, aiming to develop a national identity based on shared characteristics and preserve the nation's culture.
